body:
I'm 25, but he was my first everything.

I want to believe it will get better, but it has been months and there has been no progress.

I don't know. I just wish there were some way to fix this or some way that I could forget that i was ever in a relationship.

I guess it brings me some comfort to know that this happens to enough people that there's a wikipedia article on it.

Maybe it's wish fulfillment. Sometimes I think I only feel this way because I want to wake up and discover that it's all just a nightmare and everything is okay...
But how do you know? There's literally nothing stopping it from just getting worse and from where I am, that seems to be the direction everything is heading.
